movedToNotes.text: Tasks were selected using GPT-5.6 Luna, so this is a deliberately challenging suite.
One run shown. Each repeat resets the starting row.
Illustrative setup. The benchmark asks for the statistical trend after long observation times, rather than one bead’s exact path.
No-hint instruction shortened. General hint quoted exactly. Physics hint summarized in plain language from the actual task hint.
19 of 24 settings have complete costs. Dashed line: observed frontier. Five incomplete-cost settings are omitted.
22 of 36 settings have complete costs. Lines join observed frontiers. Historical controls and runtime differences remain.
Review subsets use different diagnostic categories. Execution errors alone do not establish a physics mistake.
Allowed tolerance: 4%. The covariance describes averages across repeated runs. Bead positions are schematic.
Historical controls and runtime differences limit causal claims. DeepSeek has many execution errors.
